parts.label: Unrolled cylinder model · Centerline radius
parts.explanation: Unroll the centerline cylinder of circumference C=2π(R+r). A helix of axial pitch p has perpendicular spacing pC/sqrt(C²+p²). Equating that spacing to2r gives p=2rC/sqrt(C²−4r²). The axial span of centerline length L is Lp/sqrt(C²+p²)=2rL/C=Lr/[π(R+r)]. For r≪R this becomes Lr/(πR). This is the elementary unrolled-strip winding model, with end effects and exact3D solid-tube contact explicitly excluded.
